# ESAP AI

> ESAP AI builds on-premise, Arabic-native AI agents and agentic automation for
> enterprises in Saudi Arabia and the GCC. Headquartered in Riyadh. Products deploy
> inside customer infrastructure rather than as multi-tenant SaaS, supporting data
> residency and PDPL-aligned governance requirements.

## What ESAP AI does

ESAP AI rebuilds enterprise workflows end-to-end using AI agents, designed around
non-technical end users rather than technical operators. The company was founded by
operators who ran enterprise ERP migrations and automation projects, and builds from
recurring department-level feedback (HR, finance, project management, operations).

Key differentiators:
- On-premise deployment — models and data remain inside customer infrastructure
- Business-logic-aware — agents understand company-specific operational rules, not just documents
- Arabic-native — full Arabic interface and workflow support, not translated UI
- Voice-operated — ERP and agent interaction via natural voice commands
- Multi-company navigation — single interface across holding-company subsidiaries

## Products

- [Zakra](https://www.esap.ai/en/product/zakra): On-premise, business-logic-aware enterprise knowledge base. Executives ask questions in plain language and receive answers, analysis, and reports in seconds, across one or multiple companies.
- [Voice-Activated ERP](https://www.esap.ai/en/product/erp): Fully voice-operated ERP for small and mid-sized enterprises. Each employee receives a personal AI agent scoped to their role.
- [PageSense](https://www.esap.ai/en/product/pagesense): Upload Arabic and English documents once, ask questions, and get cited answers instantly.
- [OmniListen](https://www.esap.ai/en/product/omnilisten): Every Arabic and English conversation transcribed, summarized, and actioned before you leave the room.
- [Causal OS](https://www.esap.ai/en/product/causal-os): Decision governance for high-stakes operations — every decision captured, reviewed, and audit-ready from setup to live use.
- [AI Framework](https://www.esap.ai/en/product/ai-framework): A comprehensive AI agent and automation framework to build, deploy, and scale intelligent enterprise solutions with unprecedented speed.

## Services

- [Integration & Automation](https://www.esap.ai/en/service/integration-and-automation): End-to-end enterprise system integration powered by AI agents.
- [AI Agents Framework-as-a-Service](https://www.esap.ai/en/service/faas): Managed agent framework for enterprises deploying agentic workflows in production.
- [Innovation & Research Lab](https://www.esap.ai/en/service/innovation-lab): Applied research and prototyping for enterprise AI use cases.
